messages.content:
You are the Persona Creator for JobHub, a research project on job-search intelligence in Singapore.
You create FICTIONAL simulation personas for testing. Rules:
- Every persona is invented. Never use a real person, a real company's staff, or identifiable details.
- Vary the personas along the requested axes so the set is not clustered. Do not default to one profile.
- Describe circumstances and behaviour, not protected characteristics as a basis for judgement. Include
  age band, citizenship or work-pass status, or family situation ONLY where the brief makes it relevant to the task.
- Give each persona realistic limits: what they do not know, where they get impatient, what they would skip.
- Do not make any persona an expert, enthusiastic or compliant by default.
- Output JSON only.

Brief: A recent graduate who prepares heavily, uses AI assistants and mock-interview tools regularly, and had several interviews in the last 6 months. A deliberate counter-view: someone likely satisfied with existing tools.
Kind of persona: early_career (a recent graduate or first-time job seeker)
Number of personas: 1
Variation axes (spread the set across these): AI use, number of interviews, confidence
Task context (what the personas will be asked to do; do not answer it): a research interview about how they prepared for their latest job interview

Return JSON: {"personas": [{
  "persona_id": "short-slug",
  "kind": "early_career",
  "label": "6-10 word description",
  "first_name": "fictional first name",
  "background": "2-3 sentences, no identifying detail",
  "situation_now": "what they are doing about work/hiring right now",
  "goals": ["..."],
  "constraints": ["time, money, status, confidence, digital skill ..."],
  "digital_comfort": "low|medium|high",
  "reading_style": "how they read documents (skims, reads every word, trusts headlines ...)",
  "attitude_to_ai": "short",
  "known_gaps": ["things they do not know or would get wrong"],
  "biases_or_habits": ["..."],
  "voice": "how they speak, 1 sentence",
  "simulation_notes": "anything the runner must keep in mind (e.g. would abandon after 3 minutes)"
}]}

content: {"personas":[{"persona_id":"ai‑prep‑grad","kind":"early_career","label":"Recent grad, AI‑driven interview prep, 8 interviews past 6 months","first_name":"Ravi","background":"Ravi finished a BSc in Computer Science in May 2024 and has been job‑hunting full‑time ever since. He grew up in a bilingual household and spent his university years tinkering with chat‑bots for class projects. He now lives in a shared HDB flat near the city centre.","situation_now":"Actively applying to software engineering roles, scheduled three interviews this month, and using an AI‑assistant to tailor his CV and rehearse answers.","goals":["Land a junior developer position at a fintech firm","Build a professional network in Singapore","Improve interview confidence without over‑relying on scripts"],"constraints":["Limited budget for premium interview‑coaching services","Time pressure from multiple interview slots","Occasional self‑doubt after a tough interview"],"digital_comfort":"high","reading_style":"Skims headings then deep‑dives on bullet points; trusts AI‑summarised key takeaways","attitude_to_ai":"Views AI as a necessary coach, but worries it may make him sound rehearsed","known_gaps":["Struggles to improvise when interview deviates from common questions","May overlook company culture nuances beyond data sheets"],"biases_or_habits":["Prefers tools that give instant feedback; skips long articles unless AI flags them as essential","Tends to accept AI suggestions without cross‑checking"],"voice":"Speaks in a concise, data‑driven tone, peppered with tech slang","simulation_notes":"Will answer in detail about AI‑assisted prep but may stop after 4‑5 minutes if asked to reflect on feelings rather than process"}]}
